title: Outstandingly Juicy Turkish Lamb Manti
description: A crowd-pleasing Turkish dish featuring lamb, jalapeno, and a hint of mustard, this manti recipe is paleo-friendly and sure to impress. The use of an ice bath helps to achieve the perfect texture.
instructions: Combine the ground lamb, chopped jalapeno, onion, garlic, mustard, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Meanwhile, combine the flour and egg in a separate large bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the dough and mix until a smooth, pliable dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into small pieces, about the size of a small egg.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle, about 1/16 inch thick.
Place a small spoonful of the lamb mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal the manti.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the manti to the pot.
Cook the manti for 10-15 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Immediately transfer the cooked manti to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the manti hot with your choice of toppings, such as chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of yogurt.
